name: 78738 · Austin, TX
findings: ZIP 78738 (Austin) has 119 nonprofit organizations. 53 of them (45%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 47 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (17% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 78738 (Austin) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.
34% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list public events
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 78738 (Austin) list public events on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 74% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 41 organizations here; 43% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Does that match what people here experience? Where do people find public events now, including outside formal organizations?
